verdict.line: You lose if you trade into an up Shadow Dash before level 6; you win if you out-farm to full build while Shen's ultimate pulls him off the map.

brief.thesis: Shen's entire kill pattern is E (Shadow Dash, cooldown 16/14/12/10/8s) landing the taunt so Q (Vorpal Blade) and autos land for free — Nasus has no mobility to avoid that taunt and no shield to answer it, so every trade before level 6 is on Shen's terms. The matchup's 43.3% win rate over 97 games reflects that lane-phase bleed, but Shen's kit does almost nothing to stop a scaled Nasus once Q (Siphoning Strike) stacks and Trinity Force come online.

theirWindow.what: Shen taunts you with E then free-hits with Q and autos for 2-3 seconds of guaranteed damage. Don't stand in minion-clear range of a 575-range E when it's up — back off a step and only trade when you've seen him use it on a minion or you've baited it.

yourWindow.when: Right after Shadow Dash lands or whiffs
yourWindow.what: E is on an 8-16 second cooldown depending on rank — the moment it's down, Shen has no way to stop you from walking up and landing Q (Siphoning Strike) and W (Wither). Wither's decelerating slow keeps him from kiting your follow-up autos during this window.

start.why: Run across 81 recorded games as the dominant start (67.5% pick) — the passive's regen and damage-reduction on being hit directly blunts the free poke Shen gets from Vorpal Blade life-tapping through minions.

boots.why: 50% win rate over 36 games, the higher-performing boot choice here — tenacity cuts the duration of Shadow Dash's taunt, shrinking the exact window Shen's whole kill combo depends on.

core.why: Core of the 61.9%-win-rate build path over 21 games — the damage and attack speed spike is what lets your stacked Q start one-shotting waves and trading back into Shen's taunt window.
Second item in that same highest-performing path — the armor and attack speed slow help you survive extended taunt-and-stick trades.
Closes out the 61.9% win-rate path, stacking with Soul Eater lifesteal so your sustain holds up through Shen's early Q poke.

the enemy team has a crit-heavy auto-attacker you need to survive instead of just Shen
you want faster wave clear and more slow uptime to punish his taunt window

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the top recorded page here (54.8% pick, 47.1% win rate) — the heal-on-hit from auto-attacking during farming trades directly offsets the chip damage Shen's Q poke stacks up pre-6.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts a 42.3% win rate at reasonable 21% pick share — Flash lets you dodge a committed Shadow Dash engage, and Teleport matches Shen's own global presence from Stand United so he can't freely leave to save or gank elsewhere without you punishing the wave.

playing.title: Farm through Shadow Dash, don't fight it
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike has only 255 range, so you cannot out-position a 575-range taunt dash. Prioritize safely landing Q on minions for stacks rather than contesting Shen's trades before level 6.

playing.title: Track Vorpal Blade's cooldown, not just E
playing.detail: Q is up every 4-6 seconds depending on rank and life-taps Shen for free sustain — if he's spamming it on minions near you, he's both poking you and healing, so disengage rather than match autos.

playing.title: Save Wither for the taunt follow-up
playing.detail: Once Shadow Dash lands on you, immediately Wither him back — the movement and attack speed deceleration stops him from kiting out of your retaliation during the taunt's forced-walk window.

playing.title: Use Spirit Fire to punish his all-in, not to start it
playing.detail: Drop E under yourself the instant he dashes in — the armor reduction and burn swing the extended trade back in your favor since he can't escape a stuck taunt animation.

playing.title: Hold R for forced fights, not free damage
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands' 120-second cooldown is long — only pop it when Shen has already committed Shadow Dash, since Feint (his self-shield) can otherwise just absorb your opening burst.

playing.title: Watch for Stand United disappearances
playing.detail: Shen's ultimate has global range and he will leave lane to use it on a losing ally fight. Every time he's gone, shove and roam — this is your biggest structural edge in the matchup.

playing.title: Don't force kills before level 6
playing.detail: Solo-kill potential is even over the sample, but Shen's kit is built to win short trades pre-6. Play for stacks and freelo farm rather than forcing the duel.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG game data on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning on cooldown windows and trade patterns is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being taunted by Shen’s Shadow Dash (E). Focus foremost on raising your [Q] and Grasp of the Undying stacks, and try to gain lane control post-level 6 with Unsealed Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R].
